scope: Independent read-only source audit of in-progress BLAKE2s adaptation; not a formal proof or completed standalone root verification

findings.property: Active RS Merkle/native/circuit personalized BLAKE2s semantics: leaf FlockLf0, parent FlockNd0, counters payload length, standard final flag.
New IV/zero/parameter constants emitted with fixed_public_input through cw; digest-bound values checked by circuit.check_public.
Public segment 1KiB leaf chunks and left-folded parents agree with native publics_digest_with_hash; bind selects B2s only in B2s mode, preserving historical SHA/B3.

Transcript virtual wide outputs expand to two domain-separated real BLAKE2s compression rows; RowHi maps to second physical low output, not ABI zero slots. Squeeze-word remapping preserves source half.
Recursive PoW checks select predicate from low physical row word1; nonce width and predicate mask constraints preserved.
AG point-binding emitter still has BLAKE3-specific nonce/XOF semantics, but both leaf/outer AG selectors explicitly false with blake2s-tower. Must not claim B2s AG support.
Synthetic MerklePathGate composite oracle uses blake3_spec while Tree uses selected kind. Tower agent notified; production collapsed path does not use this oracle.
Sequential application statement hashes 64-byte state with standard BLAKE2s256 and zero-extends output, distinct from local tagged 32-byte balanced-tree workload.
Static circuit/registry registration identifiers remain BLAKE3; no claim of eliminating every BLAKE3 assumption.

remaining_gate: Complete recursive tower build, adversarial checks and serialized root verification against independent consumer VK; owned by tower/root lanes.
